Not for students who have taken ACCT3141 Enrollment Requirements Class Attributes English only Class Availability Class Capacity 50 Wait List Capacity 999 Enrollment Total 39 Wait List Total 0 Available Seats 11 Description This course will provide a framework for students to understand the functions of accounting information systems in contemporary business organizations. System documentation skills will be introduced to enable students to fully understand a company’s business processes and its internal controls. In addition, students will learn how to build accounting information system in a database management system environment using data modeling techniques.  The course will be supplemented by laboratory sessions.
